article.title: Penalty for failure to furnish information or furnishing inaccurate information under section 195.
article.content:
271-IPenalty for failure to furnish information or furnishing inaccurate information under section 195.

Section 271-I  ·  Chapter XXI  ·  page 988 of the Act
If a person, who is required to furnish information under sub-section (6) of section 195, fails to furnish such information, or furnishes inaccurate information, the Assessing Officer may direct that such person shall pay, by way of penalty, a sum of one lakh rupees.
